newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares mixed, Klaipeda Nafta active.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares mixed, Klaipeda Nafta active.

text.p: Shares were mixed in trading on Lithuania's stock exchange on Tuesday as central market turnover rebounded and over three percent of oil terminal Klaipeda Nafta shares changed hands in block trading.
Official list shares edged down on the central market 0.17 point to 897.16, and group A shares advanced 10.93 points to 1876.00 points.
Central market volume rose to 517,000 litas from 215,000 litas at the previous session.
The market has been laid low by summer lethargy and nervousness ahead of the release of six month results.
Klaipeda Nafta turned over 2.7 million litas in block trades at a price of 100 litas, following 700,000 litas worth of block trading yesterday at the same price.
"Yesterday 0.875 percent of the shares of the company were sold and today 3.375 percent of the shares were sold," said Grazhina Bachiuliene, a broker with Vilfima.
Bachiuliene said Vilfima had handled the deal but would not disclose who was involved, saying only that it was a foreign investor.
In other trading, Snaige refrigerator producer jumped to 13.50 litas from 12.76 on central market turnover of 38,772 litas.
"There is no firm and stable demand for Snaige and the market is not stable," said one broker, but he added that Snaige was still a good long-term investment.
